description: Figure 8 is a pie chart illustrating the breakdown of time cost before and after the implementation of efficient deployment methods. The chart is divided into two segments: a large orange segment labeled "Reduction," which accounts for 60.9 seconds (69.92% of the total), and a smaller blue segment labeled "Efficient deployment," which accounts for 26.2 seconds (30.08% of the total). The chart visually emphasizes that the majority of the original 87.1-second time cost is eliminated through the reduction achieved by efficient deployment. The caption clarifies that the total time cost before deployment was 87.1 seconds (the sum of 26.2s and 60.9s), and that efficient deployment reduces this by 69.92%.
